questions.solutionHtml:
Losartan

questions.topic: eGurukul · Pharmacology - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Finasteride used to treat male pattern baldness acts by inhibiting which of the following enzyme?
questions.solutionHtml:
5-Alpha Reductase
  • Finasteride is used to treat male pattern baldness by inhibiting 5-alpha reductase.
  • Finasteride is a competitive inhibitor of 5-alpha reductase which inhibits the conversion of testosterone to its active form, dihydrotestosterone (DHT), within the hair follicles. Hence it is used in the treatment of male pattern baldness.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics - 13th edition - page 842, 1290

questions.topic: eGurukul · Pharmacology - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stemHtml: A patient who is a known addict is brought to the hospital with intoxication of an agent. Ocular examination shows the following. Which of the following is true regarding this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: This action can be reversed by phenylephrine

options.label: C
options.text: Caused due to activation of Edinger Westphal nucleus

options.label: D
options.text: Tolerance develops due to long term use

questions.answerText: Caused due to activation of Edinger Westphal nucleus
questions.solutionHtml:
Caused due to activation of Edinger Westphal nucleus
  • The image shows a pinpoint pupil (miosis). Along with the clinical scenario, it is suggestive of opioid overdose. It is caused due to activation of the Edinger Westphal nucleus.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics - 13th edition - page 376, 383

questions.topic: eGurukul · Pharmacology - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Which among the following is the false statement regarding statins?

options.label: A
options.text: Although HMG CoA reductase inhibitors substantially reduce the risk of cardiovascular events, there is mild increase in lipoprotein a (Lpa) levels

options.label: B
options.text: These drugs should not be stopped even in severe conditions like injury, surgery, etc.

options.label: C
options.text: It can be given with verapamil and other enzyme inhibitors

options.label: D
options.text: With the long term use there is slight increase in the incidence of type 2 diabetes mellitus

questions.answerText: It can be given with verapamil and other enzyme inhibitors
questions.solutionHtml:
It can be given with verapamil and other enzyme inhibitors
  • Statins like atorvastatin and rosuvastatin are metabolised by cytochrome 3A4 enzymes of the liver. Verapamil is a cytochrome 3A4 inhibitor and interferes with the metabolism of statins. Increased serum statin levels may cause myopathy in the form of myalgia and rhabdomyolysis.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics - 13th edition - page 498, 611-613

questions.topic: eGurukul · Pharmacology - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stemHtml: An antiarrhythmic drug is shown to have the following effect. It is effective both in atrial and ventricular arrhythmias. Identify the drug.
questions.solutionHtml:
Quinidine
  • Quinidine is a class IA antiarrhythmic agent. It has sodium blocking and significant potassium channel blocking properties. It prolongs QRS duration and action potential duration.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics - 13th edition - page 549, 552, 567, 569

questions.stem: Beta blocker should be avoided in all given conditions except?
questions.solutionHtml:
Glaucoma
  • Glaucoma is a group of eye diseases that result in damage to the optic nerve (or retina ) and cause vision loss. The most common type is open-angle (wide angle, chronic simple) glaucoma, in which the drainage angle for fluid within the eye remains open, with less common types including closed-angle (narrow angle, acute congestive) glaucoma and normal-tension glaucoma
